title: Vote on releasing Apache Iceberg Rust 0.11.0 RC3
summary: Danny Jones called a vote to release Apache Iceberg Rust 0.11.0 from tag v0.11.0-rc.3. He noted that the pyiceberg-core bindings now include third-party attribution notices, and the verification checklist gained an item for checking those notices in the produced wheels. Voters reported verifying signatures and checksums, that the source archive matches the tag, license files and headers, the Rust build and tests, and the pyiceberg-core build, tests and wheel notices. Four days in, the release manager said binding votes were still needed. Kevin Liu then voted and also checked that all crates can be published. The release manager announced that the vote passed and linked a separate result thread.

positions.stance: Some .github files lack license headers, but this is consistent with other Apache repositories and is not an issue.
The candidate verifies on Linux x86_64, and the vote still needed binding votes at that point.
The candidate passes the checklist, all crates pass a publish dry run on the tag, and pyiceberg-core 0.11.0rc3 was tested against PyIceberg's integration tests.

outcome.note: The release manager stated that the vote passed and pointed to a separate result thread; this thread does not give the vote counts.

why_it_matters: Iceberg Rust 0.11.0 was approved for release, with third-party attribution notices now part of the pyiceberg-core wheels and of release verification.
